theorem siftedSum_le (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) :
    (gaussSieve ℓ b K w hw).siftedSum ≤
      ((2 * K + 1) * (2 * K + 2) : ℝ) / (gaussSieve ℓ b K w hw).selbergBoundingSum +
        (w : ℝ) ^ 8 * (4 * K + 4) := by
